pages.scan: Tier 1 (wide): the top-left white caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' comes first. The teal label box top-right 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' comes next. Picture: the doctor in a white coat with her hair in a bun types at a laptop showing a setup screen with a step indicator. The window shows a sunset. Tier 2 left: 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.' The doctor has her hand on her chin and is looking up thoughtfully. Tier 2 right: 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.' The receptionist (braid, blue kurta) holds up a phone with a calendar app. Below her is the teal label 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff'. Tier 3 (wide): the doctor makes a small fist and says 'One team. Better coordination.' The receptionist stands smiling on the right holding her phone and does not speak.
pages.observation: The reading order is clear and has no competing balloons. Every tail reaches its speaker. Tier 2 left: the tail ends at the doctor's ear/temple, not her mouth, but the speaker is still clear. Tier 2 right: the tail points down to the receptionist's head. Tier 3: the tail reaches the doctor's mouth. No balloon covers a face. The tier 1 top-left caption sits just above the doctor's hair and clears her face. The 'WELBUK CARE' label in tier 2 right covers the background laptop/desk and the lower part of the receptionist's dress. Her hands and phone stay visible. Minor: the doctor's face in tier 1 is in profile and very small next to the caption. Continuity question: tiers 1-2 show a sunset at the window, but tier 3 is a different, bright daytime room (blue curtains, framed print) and there is no time or place cue. A reader may wonder whether this is later or another room. Also, the doctor wears no stethoscope in tier 1 but wears one in tiers 2-3.
